Title: Investigador(a) Postdoc CFC
Description: Ser parte del Tecnológico de Monterrey significa que tendrás la oportunidad de colaborar en una comunidad centrada en la educación, la innovación, la investigación y excelencia para transformar positivamente nuestro entorno. Aquí puedes potenciar tu talento y desarrollarte con un próposito trascendental: imaginar, emprender y construir soluciones que impactan positivamente a las personas y a la comunidad. ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti! Únete al tec y transforma el futuro junto a nosotros ¿Qué harás? Siendo Investigador(a) Postdoc CFC el reto principal es traducir los escenarios de crecimiento urbano que genera el simulador del Centro en representaciones visuales realistas y fieles al sitio real, en lugar de imágenes genéricas. ¿Cómo lo harás? Tus principales retos serán: Diseñar modelos de inteligencia artificial capaces de generar imágenes realistas a partir de los datos de planeación urbana. Construir procesos que garanticen que las imágenes generadas reflejen fielmente los cambios definidos en cada escenario (como altura, densidad o alineamiento de construcciones), evitando resultados genéricos o poco confiables. Integrar información geográfica y volumétrica del territorio como base para la generación de las imágenes. Definir métricas objetivas para evaluar la calidad y coherencia de los resultados generados, incluso cuando no existan datos de referencia con los cuales comparar.Representar visualmente el rango de resultados posibles y su nivel de incertidumbre, para apoyar la toma de decisiones. Documentar e integrar estos desarrollos como capacidades permanentes dentro de las herramientas del Centro. ¿Qué buscamos? Si tienes formación de doctorado en un área cuantitativa (matemáticas, física, estadística, ciencias de la computación, ingeniería, visión computacional, ciencia de datos, o urbanismo/diseño con formación cuantitativa), has tenido la experiencia de trabajar con modelos generativos de imágenes, y entre tus habilidades se encuentran la programación sólida en Python, el control de versiones y el diseño de esquemas de evaluación de modelos. ¡Te estamos buscando, postúlate ya! ¡Síguenos! GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. Responsibilities About the role: The IO CX Management Senior Specialist (P4) owns the operational administration, governance, data strategy, quality, and analytical enablement of the International Operations (IO) Voice of the Customer (VoC) ecosystem. The position will combine advanced analytics with experience and operational data to transform structured and unstructured customer feedback into statistical findings and actionable insights that inform priorities, strengthen decision-making, and improve customer and business outcomes. Also, it serves as the technical and analytical expert for Qualtrics XM Engage and XM Discover, related reporting platforms, and the controlled integration of experience, operational, digital, and conversational data. With solid understanding of data sources, data flows, data architecture and tools, it establishes and strengths the data strategy, data standards and data governance to be aligned with the corporate policies and standards. The role directs cross-functional delivery without requiring formal authority, manages risks and dependencies, coaches platform users and analytical partners, and is accountable for the reliability, scalability, adoption, and continuous improvement of CXM data products and platforms across IO markets. In This Role You Will CXM Data Strategy and Governance Own and execute the VoC data strategy roadmap, translating the approved CXM strategy into governed capabilities, milestones, controls, and measurable outcomes across IO markets. Establish and maintain standards for VoC data architecture, taxonomy, metadata, metric definitions, access, retention, lineage, documentation, and change control. Integrate experience data with operational, digital, transactional, and conversational inputs to improve insight quality and enable Qualtrics as the controlled source of truth for VoC. Lead structured pilots of modern data and AI capabilities, including Databricks and Qualtrics AI, with documented use cases, validation criteria, risks, controls, and adoption recommendations. Partner with CX IO, IT, Business Intelligence, Privacy, Compliance, Legal, vendors, and operational/functional teams to resolve dependencies and ensure compliant, scalable solutions. Develop and maintain VoC dashboards and insights reporting to the management team across all international markets. Qualtrics and Reporting Platforms Administration Serve as the senior administrator and product owner for Qualtrics XM Engage and XM Discover, including configuration standards, user access, roles, directories, workflows, dashboards, distributions, text analytics, and release/change governance. Own platform health routines, usage monitoring, issue logs, enhancement backlog, vendor escalation, license utilization, and business continuity controls. Design and govern survey and reporting solutions across relational and transactional programs, ensuring consistent triggers, questionnaires, embedded data, routing, notifications, close-the-loop workflows, and market comparability. Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, technical feasibility, risk, data quality, and operating impact. Create and maintain technical documentation, configuration inventories, process maps, data dictionaries, operating procedures, and audit evidence. Own business configuration and governance decisions for the CXM platform ecosystem within approved enterprise policies and technical guardrails. Data Quality, Controls and Reporting Own scheduled survey, platform, data, and reporting quality assurance, including, weekly, monthly QA before report distribution, documented evidence, issue tracking, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and prevention controls. Collaborate with Business Intelligence and IT to maintain Customer Data Platform including new enhancements that might be required by the business. Establish reconciliation and validation controls across source data, Qualtrics, Power BI, dashboards, recurring reports, and distributed outputs. Develop and maintain role-based dashboards and executive reporting that provide reliable self-service visibility while reducing manual production and inconsistent interpretation. Define service levels, quality thresholds, escalation paths, and performance measures for critical VoC data and platform processes. Identify control gaps and lead corrective improvements to protect the accuracy, confidentiality, availability, and traceability of customer feedback data. Escalate material data, platform, compliance, vendor, or delivery risks and recommend corrective action. Advanced Analytics and Customer Intelligence Lead analysis of NPS, OSAT, CES, IRR, and other experience measures using statistically valid methods that distinguish directional findings from decision-grade evidence. Develop and standardize driver-impact analysis, regression or key-driver models, segmentation, forecasting, experimentation, and impact estimation to identify the customer experience improvements that matter most. Define analytical standards and determine whether results are sufficiently reliable for reporting, prioritization, or executive decision-making. Build a consistent text analytics discipline using common taxonomies, topic modeling, sentiment, and root-cause analysis across open-text, chat, messaging, and call or conversation inputs. Analyze complex datasets using SQL, Python, R, SAS/JMP, Excel, Power BI, or equivalent tools; automate repeatable data preparation, validation, analysis, and reporting where appropriate. Present technical methods, limitations, findings, and recommendations in plain language for executives, markets, operations, and cross-functional teams. Projects, Initiatives and Stakeholder Management Prioritize the CXM data and platform backlog based on strategic value, customer impact, risk, feasibility, capacity, and cross-market scalability. Lead cross-functional workstreams and technical delivery through clear direction, operating routines, decision rights, milestones, risks, and accountability, including when contributors do not formally report to the role. Participate in regular communications and meetings with the North American and IO Customer Experience teams, as well as branch level IO Stakeholders to ensure effective coordination between groups Build networks with CXM leaders, market teams, IT, Data, Analytics, Digital, Operations, vendors, and Centers of Excellence to secure expertise and deliver shared objectives. Coach and enable users on platform standards, data literacy, statistical interpretation, dashboard use, text analytics, and quality controls. Communicate changes, address resistance, support adoption, and monitor whether new processes and capabilities deliver the intended results. Provide concise updates on delivery, risks, decisions, platform health, data quality, adoption, and business impact to CXM leadership and stakeholders. Advanced English (written and spoken) Strong written and verbal presentation skills; ability to communicate effectively with senior management and cross-functional teams. Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and JMP (Required). Advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI (Required). Advanced knowledge of SAS and R (Preferred). VBA programming skills (Preferred). Con el objetivo de convertirse en el CFO digital de todo negocio, ha desarrollado tecnología financiera que impacta en todo el ecosistema empresarial. Gracias a la data obtenida por la interacción de +1M de empresas dentro de su network , se construye un sistema de inteligencia de negocios que da visibilidad de indicadores financieros y evaluaciones de riesgo de la red con la que se colabora, ayudando a que la toma de decisiones sea más rápida y segura. Nuestros principios ¿Cómo operamos? 🎯 Ponemos a nuestros clientes en el centro ✨ Creemos e inspiramos 🧑‍💼 Actuamos como dueños 🏅 Lideramos con el ejemplo 🏆 Nos desafiamos para ganar 🧠 Tomamos riesgos con inteligencia 🤖 Usamos el poder de la tecnología ¿Qué estamos buscando? En Xepelin estamos buscando personas creativas y visionarias que piensen fuera de la caja para sumarse a nuestro equipo. Si te apasiona resolver desafíos interesantes de alto impacto y quieres ser parte de un entorno dinámico que está transformando la industria financiera, ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti! Si te motiva el desafío de construir soluciones innovadoras en un entorno de rápido cambio, queremos conocerte. Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos! Misión del rol Ser el cerebro analítico detrás de la estrategia de crecimiento de Xepelin México: definir dónde, cómo y a qué costo adquirimos clientes y convertir ese análisis en decisiones que el negocio ejecuta. El problema central es de los buenos: ¿dónde está el siguiente peso de crecimiento rentable? ¿Más Outbound, mejor pricing, otro segmento, un canal nuevo? Es un problema de asignación de capital, y tú eres quien lo modela, lo recomienda y lo acompaña hasta el resultado. Principales responsabilidades Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng ¿Qué necesitas para brillar? Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal) Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables Requisitos 2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus) Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn) SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti. Nuestros Beneficios: 🌴 Xepelin Balance Vacaciones: 15 días hábiles. Beneficios Flexibles: Puntos flexibles en tu moneda local al mes para gastar en lo que quieras. 🚀 Xepelin Performance & Career Plataformas de capacitación: Convenios con las mejores plataformas, como Udemy y Google Cloud Skill Boost. Kit de Bienvenida: todo lo que necesitas para comenzar tu viaje en Xepelin 😊 🤝 Xepelin Cares Cobertura de salud: contamos con convenios de salud con proveedores de calidad o reembolsos según el país donde te encuentres. Post Natal: te damos una semana extra de licencia post natal. ¡Nos interesa que estés con tu familia y seres queridos! Matrimonio plus: Lleva tus planes al siguiente nivel, con una gift card y extendiendo tu permiso legal por matrimonio con dos días de regalo por Xepelin. This role will define data patterns and standards, partner with IT, and business partner teams to ensure our data platform is secure, reliable, cost-efficient, and easy to use. This role is ideal for someone with strong hands-on architecture depth and can define target-state architecture, guide implementation, and ensure high-quality delivery across pipelines, integrations, and governance. Key Responsibilities Build and Own Core Data Pipelines (Hands-On) Architect and implement end-to-end ingestion and transformation pipelines from source systems into Snowflake. Develop robust ELT/ETL workflows using dbt and orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow/Dagster/ADF), including: incremental loads, SCD handling, backfills, and reprocessing late-arriving data patterns and idempotent job design CDC-based ingestion where applicable Build integrations for key enterprise SaaS systems (Salesforce, Marketing Cloud, Netsuite, Zuora, Gainsight, CSOD) and internal app databases. Data Modeling & dbt Development Own the data modeling layer in Snowflake with dbt: design dimensional models (star schemas), marts, and curated layers implement dbt best practices: staging → intermediate → marts, modular models, macros, packages define metric-ready datasets (e.g., ARR/NRR, pipeline, churn, product usage) with consistent definitions Optimize for performance and cost (clustering, warehouse sizing, query patterns, caching, micro-partitioning awareness). Cloud Platform Enablement (AWS + Azure) Implement secure, scalable data platform components across AWS and Azure: landing zones, storage (S3/ADLS), networking, secrets management, and compute integration patterns secure connectivity to Snowflake (PrivateLink/peering patterns where relevant) Work with technology teams to implement RBAC, role hierarchy, masking policies, row access policies, and data sharing patterns. Reliability, Testing, and Observability Implement data quality and reliability controls: dbt tests (schema, relationship, accepted values) and custom tests for business logic anomaly detection and pipeline monitoring (e.g., Datadog/CloudWatch/Azure Monitor, Monte Carlo if applicable) SLAs/SLOs for critical datasets and clear incident runbooks Build operational readiness: logging, alerting, retries, failure isolation, and safe deploys. CI/CD, Version Control, and Engineering Practices Build and maintain CI/CD for data development (PR checks, dbt builds, environment promotion). Establish practical engineering standards: naming conventions, repo structure, branching strategy documentation that stays current (dbt docs, data dictionaries) code reviews and design patterns that scale with the team AI / Agentic AI Architecture Design and implement architecture patterns that support AI/ML, GenAI, and agentic AI use cases across the Sales business, including structured and unstructured data pipelines, retrieval-ready data design, and secure enterprise data access. Define scalable patterns for AI-enabled applications and agents, including metadata design, indexing, vector-ready data preparation, API/tool access, and governance controls such as lineage, auditability, observability, and guardrails. Partner Closely with Analytics & Business Teams Collaborate with BI/Analytics to ensure the curated layer supports dashboards and self-service. Translate business needs into data products quickly with tight feedback loops, iterative delivery, measurable outcomes. Required Qualifications 10+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture with a strong hands-on track record. Strong production experience with Snowflake (performance tuning, data loading patterns, security model). Strong production experience with dbt: incremental models, snapshots, tests, macros, documentation, deployments Experience building pipelines and integrations in AWS and/or Azure (both preferred). Advanced SQL skills and strong understanding of data modeling (dimensional modeling, SCD types).
